comments.author: Tristan Hubsch
comments.html:
Hi, there! Nice work. Perhaps some of the following works might also grab your attention:
Classification of (World-Line) Adinkras: [arxiv:math-ph/0512016], [arXiv:0806.0050], [arXiv:0806.0051], [arXiv:0811.3410], [arXiv:0901.4970], [arXiv:1108.4124]
Filtered Clifford Supermodules: [arxiv:math-ph/0603012]
World-Sheet Adinkras: [arXiv:1104.0722], [arXiv:1104.3135]
Adinkras on (Special) Riemann Surfaces: [arXiv:1311.3736]
Adinkra Networks and Other Constructions: [arXiv:1202.4342], [arXiv:1202.4418], [arXiv:1310.3258]
Perhaps the presentation can give you some additional ideas… See, for example, p.15-18: the chart of binary linear doubly-even block codes remains unfinished essentially b/c we got kicked off supercomputer grids for hogging CPU time; a more efficient approach is needed than what is described in Appendix C of [arXiv:0806.0050]. Just in case…
Anyhow, nice to see other folks become interested in these neat objects.
Cheers, Tristan
